scientific_integrity: A proof covering all electorate sizes and exchangeable turnout laws is given. An exhaustive standard-library checker corroborates finite cases only; publication priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Assumes permutation-exchangeable turnout, a fixed nearest-neighbor/self default-delegation profile on a path, and unweighted votes. Does not assert equilibria, preference compatibility, or voting accuracy. Uniqueness requires i.i.d. 0<q<1. Fixed public source date 2025-09-17 is the verified beginning of the COMSOC 2025 workshop at which the motivating work was presented; any earlier pre-workshop public posting has not been established. A related 2026 centrality paper could not be read in full, leaving residual priority risk.
title: Sharp exchangeable-turnout loss on nearest-neighbor delegation paths
